title: Find Your Agent: dated evidence

qualification.explanation: Original reviewed public read-only responses captured through a local FYA development build, plus separately scoped archives. The paidCall archive records a returned assessment and a matching settled payment. Each archive retains its own provenance and limits; these are not a deployed-release verification or partner-track submission.
qualification.paidHireEvidenceScope: Completed ERC-8183 escrow hire; separate from the recorded x402 paid call.

selection: Three reviewed task examples selected from developer QA, a later failed local release check, and separately scoped range-assessment and paid-call archives. This is not an exhaustive run history or a success-rate estimate.

providerGroups.name: HeyAnon-associated provider group
providerGroups.basis: All three captured endpoints use erc8004.heyanon.ai and the reviewed registry names use HeyAnon branding. Treat them as one associated supply group, not three independent providers.
providerGroups.ownerScope: The raw registry response in this package directly establishes the recorded owner field for V3 Pools only. A prior development review also recorded matching Beefy ownership; that comparison is not independently reproduced by the three task downloads. Venus ownership is not established by this package.
providerGroups.limitation: Domain, branding and registry ownership observations do not establish legal ownership, beneficial ownership, independent operation or provider-signed delivery.

records.title: Discover BSC vaults
records.summary: Read 14 BSC vault entries with names, assets and provider-reported TVL/APY fields.

checks.label: Reply identifies the requested Beefy vault lookup
All returned groups and vaults identify BSC
At least one vault has an identifier, name and asset
Every vault includes numeric reported TVL and APY

task.limitation: Checks confirm the requested chain and required fields. They do not independently verify market data, returns or safety.

Inspect the exact public inputs and read-only scope.
Run once, inspect the observation time and task checks, then download the full result.
If lookup fails, the task is unavailable or payment is required, record that outcome; do not treat it as a completed task or automatically pay.

records.title: Check a public Venus account
records.summary: Read one BSC CORE reply containing reported borrow limit and shortfall.

checks.label: Reply identifies the requested Venus account lookup
One BSC CORE result; any account echo matches the request
Borrow limit and shortfall are nonnegative decimal strings

task.limitation: Checks confirm BSC, Venus CORE and decimal-shaped reported values. The provider does not echo the account in its usual reply; this record preserves the request, not independent account attribution. Units and field semantics are unconfirmed. This is not a health factor, safety judgment or ongoing protection.

paidCall.title: Paid Venus account assessment
paidCall.description: A 0.1 U x402 quote, returned Venus assessment and matching BSC settlement, with original records and separate historical RPC corroboration of all three displayed health figures at the payment block.

providerGroupsScope: The providerGroups array describes the three original records. Additional archives identify their own providers and provenance.

escrowHire.title: ERC-8183 hire and funding
escrowHire.description: Five original screenshots of hire, request review, wallet confirmations and 1 U funding for job #56751. The separately verified on-chain delivery contains an input-validation error; no successful assessment or final settlement is claimed.

escrowAssessment.title: ERC-8183 Venus account report
escrowAssessment.description: Corrected request: 1 U funded and an authentic committed Venus report submitted 102 seconds later. Partial numerical corroboration, source-time limitations and pending final settlement are retained.
